chunks.md:
## Where we are
The first release builds cleanly and every check passes. This deck shows short pieces you can play one by one or all together, each with its picture on the right. Nothing plays until you press Play.

## Next steps
| Step | What | Files | Proof | State |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S1 | Login page | app/pages/login.py | unit tests | open |
| S2 | Settings screen | app/pages/settings.py | unit tests | open |
| S3 | Export to CSV | app/export.py | sample file | open |
| S4 | Release notes | docs/RELEASE.md | review | open |
Checks so far: every area passes, and the normalizer has the most coverage.

Blocker: The export needs a new dependency.
Why: the standard library has no Excel writer.
Option 1: add openpyxl and export .xlsx
Option 2: export plain CSV only
My lean: Option 2, no new dependency.
Your call: 1 or 2?
